inspiration: Bottom power tray built from a plate, a row of empty-state slot plates, and an icon overlay per filled slot (AssetSource/Ingame/UI/HUD/Tray_Empty.svg 1200x180; Tray_Power_Icon_Empty.svg 100x100). Reads at a glance.

Status glyphs in pairs, one green and one red per state, plus a globe pair for server lists (SEGSLauncher/Resources/Icons/server_green.svg, server_red.svg, globe_green.svg, globe_red.svg). Online or offline without text.
Metal plate backdrop with a logo plate on top (SEGSLauncher/Resources/Images/ms_metal.png 1518x2150; segs-logo.png 655x639; not viewed). Worn-metal mood for a menu.
SVG source folder and PNG render folder kept apart (AssetSource to ProcessedAssets, 6 pairs, same pixel sizes): a clean asset pipeline to copy.
Per-player launcher options in a platform config file, managed from inside the launcher (README describes SEGSLauncher.conf locations). A pattern for client settings, not an asset.

briefs.label: Power tray

briefs.keep: plate plus empty-slot row plus icon overlay per slot
briefs.change: our slot count and proportions for 375 wide; our palette; bigger touch targets; a cooldown ring in place of an empty plate

briefs.label: Status glyph pair
briefs.why: Green and red dots with a globe read as online or offline with no text.
briefs.keep: a pair of glyphs per state, one colour each
briefs.change: our colours, plus shapes that work for colour-blind players; a pulse for connecting

briefs.label: Metal plate backdrop
briefs.why: A dark metal plate behind a logo gives the menu a worn, heavy mood.
briefs.keep: one large plate texture with a logo plate on top
briefs.change: our own texture and palette; a material that matches our armour look; a different edge treatment
